h: Femi Adebayo opens cinema at his Euphoria 360 Hub, offers free screenings
p: Actor Femi Adebayo has announced that the cinema at his new Euphoria 360 Hub in Lagos opens on Saturday, 7 November. The first 15 guests will be invited to the premiere of 'Jagun Jagun 2', and 45 more will get a free movie with popcorn and drinks.
body: Nollywood actor and filmmaker Femi Adebayo is set to open the cinema at his newly launched Euphoria 360 Hub in Lagos, and he is offering free treats to the first visitors.

In a video posted on Monday, 2 November 2026, Adebayo invited the public to the opening on Saturday, 7 November, at 6pm. He said the first 15 people to arrive would receive invitations to the premiere of his upcoming film 'Jagun Jagun 2', scheduled for 2 December. A further 45 people would get to watch a movie for free, with complimentary popcorn and drinks.
According to the actor, guests will be able to watch alongside some well-known entertainers, including actress Bimbo Ademoye and actor Timini Egbuson.

Femi Adebayo is one of Nollywood's leading actors and producers. His epic 'Jagun Jagun', released on Netflix in 2023, became one of the platform's most-watched Nigerian titles, and a sequel has been widely anticipated. He also produced and starred in the hit film 'King of Thieves'. The Euphoria 360 Hub adds to a growing number of entertainment venues opened by Nigerian filmmakers looking to bring audiences closer to their work. The actor was among the Nollywood stars who attended the opening of Sola Sobowale's elderly care home in Ibadan this week.
Many fans said they would turn up early to secure a place, while others congratulated the actor on the new venture.
more: The cinema opens on Saturday, 7 November, at 6pm.
The first 15 guests get invitations to the 'Jagun Jagun 2' premiere.
45 more get a free movie with popcorn and drinks.
